lore.manual_labour.workstone: A sturdy work surface. Place an item on it and strike it with a Hammer to flatten ingots into sheets, crush ores, or crack Geodes.
lore.manual_labour.mortar: A stone bowl for grinding items by hand with a Pestle.
lore.manual_labour.pestle: A tool for grinding items in a Mortar into powders, flours, and dyes.
lore.manual_labour.ladle: A tool for stirring Cauldrons. Throw ingredients into a Cauldron, then use the Spoon on it to mix them.
lore.manual_labour.millstone: A big grinding stone that mills items using Rotational Force.
lore.manual_labour.flint_hammer: A heavy hammer that hits hard but swings slowly. Strike items on a Workstone to flatten, crush, and crack them.
lore.manual_labour.iron_hammer: A heavy hammer that hits hard but swings slowly. Strike items on a Workstone to flatten, crush, and crack them.

manual_labour.ponder.mortar.text_1: The Mortar grinds items entirely by hand
manual_labour.ponder.mortar.text_3: Hold right-click with a Pestle to grind
manual_labour.ponder.mortar.text_5: Shift-right-click with a Pestle to rest it on the Mortar
manual_labour.ponder.mortar.text_6: Fluids can be poured in or drawn out with a bucket
